name: Tractial S.A.
summary: Tractial S.A. operates in France, specializing in a variety of payment solution services. Their portfolio of offerings features StarPass, a payment system tailored for the gaming industry; Toneo First, a re-loadable prepaid payment card; PayDuo, a mobile application designed for convenient digital payments; and Payment.net, a robust platform for processing online transactions. Currently known as BD Multimedia SA, the company is set to officially change its name to Tractial S.A. in August 2025. This firm was established in 1986 and maintains its primary corporate offices in Paris, France.
